config.classifier: leave-one-out nearest centroid, z-scored per fold

identical_parameters.note: same Condition tuple, different RNG stream; nothing was manipulated between the two groups

f0_recovery.note: descriptor f0_mean against the generator's base pitch; per-burst jitter moves the true mean, so this bounds the error rather than measuring it exactly

frame_tracks.rounding: f0_hz to 0.01 Hz, rms to 1e-4, voiced_share to 0.01, confidence to 1e-4, times_s to 1e-3 s
